name: prson-login-sdk-workspace
description: npm-workspaces root for the login SDK. Holds no published code; exists so a single `npm install` at this level installs deps for both `packages/browser` and `packages/browser-ui`, and `npm run build:example` rebuilds both bundles into the plain-HTML demo. `npm run build:vendor` rebuilds every committed browser bundle (the plain-HTML demo and prson-website/public/vendor/prson-login/); `npm run check:vendor` fails if any of them is stale (CI runs it).
